warden of Huggens College, Northfleet

He acted as locum tenens for the Rev.

Henry Bowles, Vicar of Otterbourne, during a holiday.

There is information about him and the college on the pages maintained by the Kent Archaeological Society at www.kentarchaeology.org.uk.
